pages.reply: The user management screen is complete: a sidebar admin shell with a sortable/filterable/paginated user table (name, role, status, last sign-in), invite/reset-password/deactivate flows via accessible modals and row-action menus, bulk selection actions, toast feedback, and keyboard/focus-trap/aria su

Note: the skill's `search.py` design-system lookup was blocked by environment command-approval restrictions (confirmed via both a subagent and a direct Monitor call), so this build uses the skill's built-in priority-table defaults (accessibility, touch targets, typography, style/layout guidelines) r
